footer.line1: Farm Profitability: loot calculation and chest simulation.
footer.line2: All data is stored locally in your browser.
footer.creditPrefix: A big thank-you to ColdGun for painstakingly putting together the "Прибыльность данжей" spreadsheet. Check out

mainPage.title: Loot Calculation
mainPage.subtitle: Pick chests, enter the count, and compare expected loot with actual results.
mainPage.compositionHint: Add one or more rows with a chest type and count. Coming from the advanced calculator fills this in automatically.
mainPage.noChests: Add at least one chest to see the calculation.
mainPage.emptyRowWarning: Select a chest type for every row

advancedCalc.title: Dungeon Profitability
advancedCalc.subtitle: Dungeon farming profitability: character count, double reward, time per run.
advancedCalc.dungeonsHint: Check the dungeons you farm — an estimated daily profit is shown next to each, using the current settings.
advancedCalc.periodHint: Choose the period for which accumulated chests should be calculated on the loot page.

validation.charactersRange: Number of characters must be between 1 and 1000
validation.periodTooLong: Total period must not exceed 10,000 days
validation.periodAmountMin: Period amount must be at least 1

simulator.title: Chest Simulator
simulator.subtitle: Choose a chest and the number of openings. Each chest produces exactly one random outcome.
simulator.warningOverLimit: More than 100,000 openings may take noticeably longer.
simulator.invalidData: Chest probabilities do not add up to 100%. Simulation has been stopped.
simulator.contentsSubtitle: Each opening selects one row using its probability. Quantity is the size of the awarded stack.
simulator.selectChestFirst: Choose an amount and open the chests. All received rewards will appear here.

prices.title: Item Prices
prices.subtitle: Edit item prices. Changes are saved only in this browser — everyone has their own local version of the prices.

probabilities.title: Drop Probabilities
probabilities.subtitle: Configure item drop chances per chest.
probabilities.independentNote: Item chances within a chest are independent, so their sum can exceed 100% — that's expected.
probabilities.duplicateWarning: This item has multiple rows in this chest whose chances sum above 100%

validation.chestCountRange: Chest count must be between 0 and 1,000,000
validation.simulationsRange: Number of simulations must be between 1 and 10,000
